name: @red-cup-engineering/codex-actuator-client-service
description: Parameterized Codex-side evidence selection and external actuator invocation without domain doctrine or generated skills.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: explicit roots, selectors, actuator coordinates, and injected transports
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: ambient repository discovery, implicit providers, credential-shaped evidence, unreceipted effects, or domain-specific policy

select-bounded-evidence.accepts: an explicit root, literal query, byte and result bounds, and caller-selected exclusion globs
select-bounded-evidence.returns: a digest-bound ordered evidence source cover

invoke-external-actuator.accepts: an actor, operation, arguments, caller authority evidence, and injected transport
invoke-external-actuator.returns: a digest-bound invocation receipt preserving provider result and optional independent verification
